components.name: Blender
components.security: Install only from blender.org or an operating-system package manager.

components.name: Blender MCP
components.security: Arbitrary Python execution is intended. Bind to localhost only, disable telemetry, and keep remote asset-download integrations disabled.

components.name: Pillow
components.security: Install from PyPI or an operating-system package manager. The encoder reads only locally rendered PNG frames and writes one GIF.

components.name: Roblox Studio MCP
components.security: Use Roblox's built-in Studio MCP and verify the active place before executing Luau.

components.name: Blender Animations (ultimate edition)
components.security: Install only from the Creator Store listing. Keep auto-connect and live sync off unless Studio transfer is actively required.

components.name: Roblox Animations Importer/Exporter
components.security: Use the upstream release. Keep online access and live sync disabled unless required for transfer.
components.installation: Install and enable manually in Blender before using the skill.
